{{Top}} {{Update|[[Star Wars Outlaws]]}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:Teeka-2024HighTek.png]] |name=Teeka |homeworld=[[Tatooine]]{{Kenobi|Part I}} |birth= |death= |species=[[Jawa]] |gender= |pronouns=She/her{{Databank|teeka|Teeka}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]] |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Teeka's tribe]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|«''Trouble with your vaporator?''»
"''Yes, I had some parts stolen. I need a new processor board.''"
«You're in luck.''»
"''Teeka, if you're gonna steal my parts and sell them back to me, could you at least clean them first as a courtesy?''"
«Cleaning costs extra.''»|Teeka and Obi-Wan Kenobi|formatting=0|}} '''Teeka''' was a [[Jawa]] who resided on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] and was part of a [[Teeka's tribe|Jawa tribe]] in [[9 BBY]]. She searched for a [[T-16 skyhopper]] [[Luke Skywalker's T-16 skyhopper model|toy]] and delivered it to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a [[Jedi Master]], who gave Teeka seventy-five [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. Teeka, who had stolen Kenobi's [[moisture vaporator]] [[processor]] board, offered it to Kenobi, who bought it stating that if Teeka stole his parts, that she should at least clean them, and rejected a [[Jedi]] [[belt]] the Jawa had retrieved from a [[starship]]. ==Biography== ===Always hustling=== {{Quote|"''You're late.''"
«''Do you have the credits this time?''»
"''Do you have it?''"
«''A hundred. It's very rare. They don't make these anymore.''»|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Teeka discuss the T-16 skyhopper toy|formatting=0|}} Teeka was a [[Jawa]] [[Merchant|trader]]{{SW|url=news/obi-wan-kenobi-disney-plus-quotes|text=25 of the Best Quotes from ''Obi-Wan Kenobi''}} who dwelt on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] with her [[Teeka's tribe|tribe]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Her clients consisted of those searching for scraps of technology or other junk, including the hermit [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who requested that she find him a [[T-16 skyhopper]] [[Luke Skywalker's T-16 skyhopper model|toy]], as he wished to gift it to the [[youngling]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I}} Teeka and her tribe discovered a [[Jedi starfighter]] in the wastes that the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Nari]] had flown to Tatooine while fleeing from the [[Inquisitorius]]. The Jawas stripped it for parts, salvaging a [[Jedi utility belt]] among other things. [[File:Teeka-OWKpI.png|thumb|left|250px|Teeka negotiates with Kenobi over parts.]] Teeka also stripped parts including the processor board from the [[moisture vaporator]] above the [[Ben Kenobi's cave|cave]] where Kenobi dwelt in the [[Dune Sea]] on the edge of the [[Jundland Wastes]].{{Kenobi|Part I}} She later returned to visit Kenobi in the cave with a floating scrap cart that carried the toy he sought as well as the parts from the [[starfighter]] and vaporator. Arriving late, the Jawa found Kenobi sat eating when she arrived and greeted him by complaining about his smell. When Kenobi asked after the toy, Teeka initially questioned if he would be able to pay for it and asked for one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], claiming the toy was rare since it was no longer made. Kenobi haggled her down to seventy-five credits for the grimy and broken toy, after which the pair heard the vaporator begin sputtering above them. ===Jedi = profit=== {{Quote|You need anything else? I have a whole new batch of salvage. Here, look… we stripped that Jedi's old ship. Found it out in the wastes.|Teeka|}} Teeka questioned if the device was working and when Kenobi mentioned the stolen parts she offered him the processor board. The hermit revealed that he knew it was Teeka who had stolen it in the first place and requested that she at least clean the parts if she wished to sell them back to him. Teeka did not deny the theft but merely pointed out that cleaning would cost extra. Taking the toy and board, Kenobi got out his credits, at which point the Jawa attempted to sell him the [[belt]] from the starfighter, telling him about the fugitive Jedi and claiming that she hoped there would be more Jedi since they were good for business. Kenobi—who, unbeknown to Teeka, was himself a Jedi in hiding—told her that it was unlikely there would be any more since the Jedi were all but extinct. Returning the belt, he then paid the grumbling Teeka and bid her farewell, after which the Jawa left. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Should have brought some soap. I could smell you from Anchorhead.|Teeka greets Kenobi|}} [[File:Teeka-2023Base.png|thumb|right|200px|Teeka was not above stealing equipment to sell back to the victim.]] Teeka was a shrewd entrepreneur and a hustler who aimed to sell her wares at a mark-up to her clients using her deal-making prowess. What she lacked in height, she made up for in attitude, although she was still charming despite not always being honest. She particularly enjoyed looting salvage from [[podracing]] events.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' When dealing with Kenobi, she opened and ended her interaction with him by complaining about his smell, claiming she could have smelt him all the way from the settlement of [[Anchorhead]]. She was also willing to steal from the hermit and sell him back his own possessions, not denying it when confronted and even refusing to clean the items before returning them. Teeka spoke in [[Jawaese]] and had [[Color|orange]] [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Teeka was a skillful mechanic who was able to handle almost any machine or vehicle with great results. She had a wide reputation for being a clever entrepreneur, being able to sell things at a great mark-up and earning her tribe great profits.''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' ==Equipment== {{Quote|You need anything else? I have a whole new batch of salvage. Here, look… we stripped that Jedi's old ship. Found it out in the wastes.|Teeka|}} Teeka wore brown [[Clothing|robes]] with brown [[glove]]s, brown foot wrappings, and a [[bandolier]]. She also carried a [[Jawa ionization blaster]].{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|packtype=Special Action Figure Set|pack=#257-259: ''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' (Obi-Wan Kenobi, Teeka, & Purge Trooper)|altlink=https://www.banthaskull.com/story/news-official-reveal-the-vintage-collection-star-wars-obi-wan-kenobi-multipack}} Her wares included scraps of technology and other junk which she transported on a floating scrap cart. When visiting Kenobi she brought the T-16 skyhopper toy in a satchel, Kenobi's processor board, and Nari's Jedi utility belt, among other parts. ==Behind the scenes== Teeka was portrayed by [[Leilani Shiu]] in "[[Part I]]" of the [[Disney+]] show ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early.
